en: Six rule variants, fair action selection and dynamically balanced assignments.
Experiment v2 statistics are separate from historical games.
Standard and variant rules share one screen, with a rule comparison before switching.
Blotto restores free allocation: 66 standard options, with 255 history-selected model candidates in the four-field variant.
zh: 六种泛化规则、公平出招与动态均衡分配。
新实验数据独立统计，历史数据保留。
常规与泛化共用同一界面，切换时弹窗对比规则。
布洛托恢复自由分兵：常规人机均66种，四地域泛化模型保留255个历史估算候选。
